title: Condensed Whitehead Problem
summary: The Whitehead problem, which asks whether every abelian group $A$ satisfying $\mathrm{Ext}^1(A,\mathbb{Z}) = 0$ is free, is independent of ZFC. However, this problem has an analogue in condensed mathematics that can be answered affirmatively. In this note, we give a new proof that an abelian group $ A $ of size $κ$ is free if and only if $\underline{\mathrm{Ext}}^1(\underline{A}, \underline{\mathbb{Z}})(S_κ) = 0$, where $ S_κ$ is the Stone space of the Boolean completion of $\operatorname{Add}(ω,κ)$.
